# secopsctl status

Show read-only diagnostics: capabilities, coverage, surfaces

## status capabilities

Show tool version, auth health, surface status, and read-only state

```text
secopsctl status capabilities [flags]
```

```text
One call that fuses `version`, `doctor`, and `surfaces`: the tool build, auth
health per plane (SIEM ADC vs SOAR AppKey), read-only state, and a summary of
which API surfaces are validated vs blocked. Intended as the first call of an
automated session so an agent knows — without trial and error — what works on
this instance. --offline skips the live auth/reachability probe.

Pair with `secopsctl commands --json` (per-verb flags/types) for the full
machine-readable surface.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--offline` | bool | false | skip the live auth/reachability probe (version + surfaces + read-only only) |

## status coverage

Read-only: MITRE ATT&CK detection coverage (threat-collection × rule)

```text
secopsctl status coverage [flags]
```

```text
Report detection coverage details (coverageDetails) — the per threat-
collection × rule MITRE ATT&CK coverage the platform computes: which
techniques deployed rules cover. JSON output; a coverage-posture input for
detection engineering and SOC reporting.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | int | 1000 | max coverage rows to return |

## status enums

List known SOAR enum values (case priority, close reason, SLA, block-list, stages, categories)

```text
secopsctl status enums [flags]
```

```text
Print every SOAR enum the SDK knows about — the integer-to-name
mappings the legacy API uses. With --live, also fetches dynamic
values from the instance (case stages, playbook categories).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--live` | bool | false | also fetch dynamic values from the instance (stages, categories) |

## status surfaces

List every API surface family and how it's operated (read-only, offline)

```text
secopsctl status surfaces
```

```text
Print the surface-family registry: each API family's plane (host + auth), API
version, lane (reconcile / imperative / raw / operational), build status, and —
for reconcile surfaces — whether `--prune` can delete it. The map of what is
reconcilable vs read-only. Reads nothing live; --json for scripting.
```
